integrity: The proof is self-contained relative to standard Lipschitz ODE and monotone-coupling facts. Finite exact calculations are independent diagnostics rather than infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns fair independent sum/min operators and iid zero/one leaves with positive-leaf probability tending to zero; finite-clock convergence is conditional and in total variation, while the large-clock result is only fixed-finite-set escape. No general rescaling theorem or independent priority certification is claimed.
title: Sparse-leaf kinetic crossover for the critical min-plus binary tree
